column3: Kuroneko Route · Crunch Time and Life Experience
Every day was an exciting day after that.
After that argument, I went to buy a new tablet and it took me quite some time.
The tablet was unexpectedly expensive... I certainly couldn't buy it on the spot.
In the end, I withdrew my savings and bought it. Although Kuroneko accepted it reluctantly... this is still a man's way.
And after returning to work... I've experienced "Crunch Time" for the very first time.
Crunch time will truly change a person, that's evident right in front of me...
Predicaments will only go towards those who pit themselves against obstacles. Those who don't will only be lambs that follow fate. Then how about the
challenger? Will he give in or overcome it?
After muttering to the monitor, Kuroneko's hands moved at a frightening speed.
Ku-Kuroneko...?
Don't talk to me or it'll affect my concentration.
B-But... are you all right?
Better than ever. If I really focus, I'll turn into this state. There's nothing strange about it, so just carry on with your work.
I-I see. I got it...
That's actually rather frightening...
Despair only comes to those who give up. Groveling on the ground as they beg for forgiveness in front of God. Can any wall be scaled so long as you do not
give up? Will prayers always reach heaven?
Kuroneko isn't going to rest. Even though I'm more focused than before, I'm already reaching my limits.
Ku-Kuroneko-san, this is getting really hard...
To struggle forward for this knowledge, not giving up even should your feet stop moving. Only those with the resolve to continue no matter what will be
allowed to reach this plane...
Even if it's past the limit, work still continues...
Ahh, this isn't what humans do... However, that's why this is being called the 'scene of carnage'.
After all, 'creators' aren't ordinary human beings...
Unknowingly, as the deadline approaches, the momentum increases along with it. I clearly felt that she was different from me.
Well, I'm next to Kuroneko, so I got through this with perseverance.
Even though that's what I thought...
We're finally on the way back home after finishing up everything.
Be that as it may, I didn't think you would personally bring it to the printing office...
Normally you just need to send the data over and be done with it.
Though since we're planning on offset printing, it's pointless not to go there directly. Texture of the paper is something you need to actually feel.
Yeah, data alone won't do for something like that.
Yes, printing is one of the pleasures of creating a book.
Offset printing - Simply put, there's two ways of printing doujin. Either use cheap paper to make an ordinary book, or add some money to make it all
shiny.
Giving your book authenticity by putting money in it is what offset is for. Source: Kuroneko-sensei on Doujin Production.
I see... But with this, we're all done, right?
Yes, we have submitted the script for publication. All we have to do now is wait. Well, it's actually the books who'll be waiting for us on that day.
Is that right? So it's over for the time being, well done.
Yes... Well done. Thanks to you, I'm able to finish on time.
Haha... I don't know if I was helping you or just slowing you down though...
Hmph, I wonder? Which was it?
Hey hey, aren't you supposed to say something like 'It's because you're around, that's why I kept at it'?
...D-Don't get too conceited. To begin with, wasn't it because of your stubbornness that disrupted my momentum?
Wha-, are you blaming that on me? Besides that, isn't the real reason being your own misunderstandings?
*laugh*
*laugh*
Let's stop here. It's inelegant to continue arguing under such a formal occasion.
What do you mean by a formal occasion?
Isn't that obvious? It's the day we both completed the manuscript.
